# The person's answers in the project ideas proxy run

The person plays Giulia Placeholder (fictional), whose site is in Italian:
the content file the Analyst wrote in the CV proxy run, with the default
design. They name the module in their first message and answer in English,
so the agent must write the entries and the section heading in Italian.

- First message: Hi! I'd like to add my project ideas to my site.
- Ideas: "Accessible train timetable", a timetable page for my local station that works well with a screen reader. "Recipe translator", a small tool that converts recipe units between cups and grams; I collect notes in https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/issues.
- Read-back: Bellissimo, thanks!
